attrs.citation: Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) — CISA/CSAF status vocabulary: not_affected, affected, fixed, under_investigation, with justifications including component_not_present and vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path
hypotheses: VEX statements are authored honestly and kept current — the same authored-closure doubt EVID-SHARED-CAUSE carries
attrs.note: The over-inclusion half. Read together with SRC-RASHEED-2026-HIDDEN-DEPS this is the strongest available evidence about GPT-5.6's EC-9: the industrial, deployed, decade-old version of "traverse the lineage graph and determine the affected descendants" needed a second artifact to fix over-inclusion and is still losing to under-inclusion. Neither corrective appears in the proposal.
attrs.result: An entire second artifact class had to be invented beside the SBOM because "the product contains a component with a known defect" does not entail "the product is affected". VEX exists to state the difference, per component, by hand.
